rules.alternatives: No separate state hour count: renewal requires documented evidence that the PA met the NCCPA continuing medical education and recertification requirements (including the NCCPA recertification exam) and is currently NCCPA certified.

topics.who: Pain management and opioid use and addiction, verified at application for the permanent license (NCCPA-approved, AMA Category I or AOA Category I/II CME); waived until the PA applies for a DEA registration number

rules.notes: License renewed biennially on the date set by the department. The 2-hour opioid course is an application requirement (12 AAC 40.400), not repeated at renewal in 12 AAC 40.470. Board website blocked to scripts; facts from the Alaska Administrative Code.
